name: penv
description: Diagnostics, completion and hover for .env.schema from the penv binary: @rotate, @hosts, @assert, penv() and every @env-spec decorator penv reads.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: penv.path can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot choose the program this extension starts.

penv.path.markdownDescription: The `penv` binary to run. Empty finds it on `PATH`, including behind an `npm i -g @penvhq/cli` install.

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:vscode --minify --outfile=dist/extension.js && esbuild src/find.ts --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/find.js && esbuild test/suite/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:vscode --outfile=dist/test/suite/index.js && esbuild test/run.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:@vscode/test-electron --outfile=dist/test/run.js
